description: Source code for a Markdown text splitter component implementing the INode interface, with functionality to split Markdown content based on headers or fallback to default splitter.

classes.name: MarkdownTextSplitter_TextSplitters
classes.description: A class implementing INode to split Markdown text based on headers or default splitter.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the splitter with parameters from nodeData, returning either a splitter or functions to split documents/text based on headers.

methods.name: splitByHeaders
methods.description: Splits Markdown text into sections based on header levels.

methods.name: getHeaderLevel
methods.description: Converts header level string (h1-h6) to numeric level.
